item.title: Black nurses faced alleged racial abuse at Vermont home; Elderwood agrees to $450,000 settlement
item.description: The settlement of $450,000 addresses allegations of racial harassment faced by Black nurses during the COVID-19 pandemic. Employees reported incidents involving racial slurs and threats from residents at Elderwood at Burlington. The lawsuit was filed by the EEOC, claiming the operators failed to protect their employees from harassment. New measures will be introduced, including updated anti-discrimination policies and training programs for staff. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: El sistema de salud de Cuba enfrenta una profunda crisis marcada por el aumento de la mortalidad infantil, la reducción de la esperanza de vida y la escasez de medicamentos, insumos y personal médico. item.title: Depression may be an early warning sign of Alzheimer's disease
item.description: Depression in older adults may be more than a mental health concern. Scientists discovered that accumulating tau protein, a hallmark of Alzheimer's disease, was linked to worsening depressive symptoms in people who still had normal memory and thinking abilities. The faster tau built up in the brain, the faster depressive symptoms increased, suggesting that mood changes could emerge before cognitive decline. Fuente: ScienceDaily.

item.title: Woman dies after lung cancer goes undetected on MRI; jury awards family $8 million
item.description: An Oregon jury awarded nearly $8 million to the estate of Wendi K. Lui and her husband after finding a radiology group and its hospital partner liable for missing a lung mass on her 2019 breast MRI. The cancer was detected during a scan in 2020, by which time it had spread to her lymph nodes. Lui died of metastatic lung cancer in 2023, aged 51. Her husband rejected settlement offers and pursued a trial to bring attention to the case. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Los jóvenes están cada vez más ansiosos y este factor psicológico es una de las principales causas
item.description: Que los jóvenes tienen más problemas de ansiedad que las personas de más edad es algo que tenemos más que comprobado. Si los millennials ya veníamos pisando fuerte en ese sentido, los más jóvenes (porque los millennials también somos jóvenes, ¿vale?) lo tienen aún más crudo. En España los trastornos de ansiedad son el problema de salud mental más registrado en la adolescencia, con 34,6 casos por cada 1.000 habitantes. Pero no es solo una cuestión española. En Estados Unidos, por ejemplo, también se está dando cada vez más esta tendencia. Por eso es tan importante el estudio realizado… Fuente: Xataka.
